name: Kohinata Saki
source:
"It's not every day you see such close sisters. You two look more like a pair of lovers."

The twins' childhood friend and a classmate of [url=/c43541]Futaba's[/url], Saki is a talented cook who pampers her friends with all the love and warmth of a new bride. Her deep concern for her friends leads her to being overprotective, and she can be as fierce as a mother cat with her kittens when it comes to any perceived threat. 

Saki is a member of the tennis club, and despite her docile appearance, she’s a gifted athlete. 

Since they're in both the same club and the same class, Saki looks out for Futaba when [url=/c43540]Ichika[/url] isn’t around. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=1074]MangaGamer[/url]]
